summary.en: US stock futures edge lower as April CPI accelerated to 3.8% year-over-year, the highest since May 2023, reinforcing 'higher-for-longer' rate expectations.
summary.zh: 美股市期货小幅下跌，4 月 CPI 加速至 3.8%，为近三年最高，强化了'higher-for-longer'的利率预期。

en.title: April CPI Accelerates to 3.8% - Highest in Nearly Three Years
en.impact: Consumer prices rose faster than the 3.7% consensus, with core inflation at 2.8% versus 2.7% expected.

zh.title: 4 月 CPI 加速至 3.8% - 近三年最高
zh.impact: 消费者物价增速快于 3.7% 的共识，核心通胀为 2.8% 对立于 2.7% 预期。

topNews.macroRisk: Yes - Inflation surge from Iran war impact limits Fed easing

en.title: Trump Calls Iran Ceasefire 'On Life Support' - Oil Spikes Near $105/Bbl
en.impact: President Trump's remarks on Iranian ceasefire fragility drove oil prices higher.

zh.title: 特朗普称伊朗停火'维持生命' - 油价飙升至近每桶 105 美元
zh.impact: 特朗普总统关于伊朗停火脆弱性的言论推动了油价上涨。

topNews.macroRisk: Yes - Escalating US-Iran tensions threaten energy supply routes

en.title: Treasury Yields Push Higher on Hot Inflation Print
en.impact: The 10-year Treasury yield rose 2 basis points to 4.433%.

zh.title: 美债收益率因通胀数据飙升走高
zh.impact: 10 年期美债收益率上升 2 个基点至 4.433%。

topNews.macroRisk: No - Bond market pressure from elevated inflation

en.title: S&P 500 Holds Above 7,400 Despite Yield Spikes
en.impact: Wall Street closed at record highs on Monday with S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 advancing.

zh.title: 标普 500 尽管收益率飙升仍坚守 7400 上方
zh.impact: 华尔街周一以标普 500 和纳指 100 创下新高收盘。

topNews.macroRisk: No - Strong equity momentum despite yield headwinds

en.title: Trump-Xi Summit Preview: Trade and AI to Dominate Beijing Agenda
en.impact: US President Trump's high-stakes meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping this week focuses on trade negotiations.

zh.title: 特朗普 - 习近平峰会预览：贸易和 AI 将主导北京议程
zh.impact: 美国总统特朗普本周与中国国家主席习近平的会晤聚焦贸易谈判。

ai.en: AI sector faces mixed signals as chip-led rally meets yield pressure.
ai.zh: AI 板块面临混合信号：芯片领头的 rally 遭遇收益率压力。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductor stocks cool after record closes.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体股票在创纪录收盘后冷却。

bigTech.en: Broad tech volatility emerging as inflation data weighs on growth valuations.
bigTech.zh: 广泛的科技波动出现，因通胀数据给成长估值带来压力。

energy.en: Energy sector on risk bid as Brent crude climbs toward $105/barrel.
energy.zh: 能源板块因布伦特原油向每桶 105 美元攀升面临风险。

ev.en: EV sector mixed on divergent dynamics.
ev.zh: 电动车板块在分化动态中混合。

market.en: S&P 500 records weekly gains despite Tuesday dip.
market.zh: 标普 500 创周收益尽管周二下跌。

preciousMetals.en: Gold under pressure from inflation-driven rate expectations.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金因通胀驱动的利率预期承压。

oil.en: Brent crude surging toward $105/barrel on US-Iran stalemate.
oil.zh: 布伦特原油在特朗普'停火维持生命'言论附近每桶 105 美元飙升。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures down 0.35% to ~7,410; Nasdaq 100 futures lower 0.77% toward 29,200.

dxy.en: Dollar stable to moderately stronger as inflation data supports real yields.
dxy.zh: 美元稳定到中等更强，因通胀数据支持真实收益率。

oil.en: Brent crude surging near $105/barrel on Trump's 'ceasefire on life support' remarks.
oil.zh: 布伦特原油在特朗普'停火维持生命'言论附近每桶 105 美元飙升。

keyRisk.en: Middle East geopolitical escalation risk - Trump's rejection of Iran's ceasefire proposal.
keyRisk.zh: 中东地缘政治升级风险 - 特朗普拒绝伊朗停火提议。

note.en: AI momentum and energy sector strength offset rate-sensitive headwinds from 3.8% CPI print.
note.zh: AI 势头和能源部门强度抵消 3.8% CPI 数据带来的利率敏感逆风。
